summary.text: Brad Yeager represents District 56 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Yeager was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: The House lists Yeager's residence as New Port Richey and an occupation of general manager in the automotive industry and small business owner. Yeager moved to Florida in 1978 and graduated from Charlotte High School in Punta Gorda in 1994.

sources.title: Biography for Representative Bradford Troy "Brad" Yeager
